component.name: MainScene
component.script:
sub init() m.panelSet = m.top.findNode("panelSet") m.menuPanel = CreateObject("roSGNode", "MenuPanel") m.panelSet.appendChild(m.menuPanel) m.menuPanel.setFocus(true)
m.loadTimer = m.top.findNode("loadTimer") m.loadTimer.observeField("fire", "onLoad") m.loadTimer.control = "start" m.reportTimer = m.top.findNode("reportTimer") m.reportTimer.observeField("fire", "onReport") end sub
sub onLoad() content = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for i = 1 to 3 content.createChild("ContentNode").title = "Menu " + i.toStr() end for m.menuPanel.content = content print "content assigned, numPanels = "; m.panelSet.numPanels m.reportTimer.control = "start" end sub
sub onReport() m.top.report = m.panelSet.numPanels end sub
